summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, furnishing its Monthly Return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for June 2026. This regulatory filing reports routine movements in authorized and issued share capital, showing a small increase of 13,006,712 ordinary shares due to share option exercises. There is no transaction, no price, no premium, no board recommendation, and no advisory involvement. The filing is a standard monthly compliance report required under Hong Kong Listing Rules and does not constitute a special situation event.
